title: Tabs size and line variant
prompt: Designers want our Tabs (`src/components/ui/tabs.tsx`, shadcn) to support sizes (`sm`, `default`, `lg`) and a `line` style, chosen once per tabs group. The settings page fakes both with classes on the list and every trigger; move it to the new API. Other screens must look exactly the same as today.

criteria.text: `size` and `variant` are a typed `cva` on TabsList, the container part that owns the look: set once per tabs group on the list (not on the Tabs root, not repeated on each trigger) and mirrored as `data-size`/`data-variant`; `compoundVariants` handle combinations such as the line list's height per size.

Triggers read the list's configuration through DOM mechanisms: data attributes on TabsList plus named group selectors (e.g. group/tabs-list + group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:). A React context or store for these styling values is a fail, as is cloneElement.

With size/variant omitted, every part renders exactly the previous base classes (ProjectTabs unchanged visually); existing base classes are not rewritten or lost; Radix props (orientation, activationMode, disabled etc.) still pass through.
Settings page uses `<TabsList size="lg" variant="line">` (or equivalent on the list) and drops the per-trigger patch classes; only genuine page layout classes remain (e.g. width/justify).

Each slot maps the semantic values to its own styles (list container vs trigger target/typography vs line underline). The line variant has a distinct active state (for example an underline) and keeps the base focus-visible and disabled styles. Hover or muted-inactive treatment is not required, because neither the base Tabs nor the old settings page has one.
Long class lists are grouped by concern as ordered `cn(...)` arguments (base first, variants grouped, consumer className last) or a typed CVA; not one unreadable string per slot.
The size/variant API is typed through the cva (`VariantProps<typeof tabsListVariants>`); invalid values are type errors; defaults are explicit and `data-*` mirrors the resolved values.
Change stays focused: no unrelated primitives rewritten, no new dependencies, no speculative extra sizes/variants beyond the request; typechecks.
